summary: Backend-only testing of SOCPilot soc_engine fixes for 3 NEW offenses (auth 2d819087, proxy aa245d82, firewall-permit 74733a74) plus regressions for CTI b3d62492 and UC-00508 0d75ac25. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_18.py with 5 pytest cases asserting grounded field extraction (logon type/workstation/status; URL/method/port; policy/zones/bytes/packets), correct branch routing (no malware/persistence wording in proxy report, no DNS-tunnel/CTI routing for firewall-permit, no CTI 'internally hosted service' in impact), clean field extraction (no offense-description bleed into aged-out session_end_reason), absence of 'Historical similar incident' text, and preservation of the CTI 6-sentence analyst template + UC-00508 persistence content. All 5 tests PASS against public URL. Login flakiness observed once (Cloudflare 502 while backend was restarting from OpenRouter 429 loop) — resolved on retry.

minor.issue: Frequent 429 Too Many Requests seen in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log for openrouter/free during test runs. Rule-engine fallback correctly retains deterministic report, so no functional regression, but noise in logs. Consider backoff/circuit-breaker.

'Historical similar incident' text confirmed absent across all 5 offenses' reports.
